item.title: Codex API Key Setup (2026): Login Command, Billing and Limits
item.description:
Codex API key setup means signing the Codex CLI in with an OpenAI API key instead of your ChatGPT account. You put the key in the OPENAI_API_KEY variable and run codex login --with-api-key. OpenAI’s Codex auth page says API key use is billed at standard API rates, and that some features that need a ChatGPT workspace or cloud access are not available.

Set up the API key

  1. Get a key. Create one in the OpenAI dashboard. The key belongs to your OpenAI Platform account.
  2. Export it. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in your shell, for example in your shell profile. Avoid pasting the key into shell history.
  3. Log in. Run printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex login --with-api-key. The key goes in through stdin, so it does not appear in the command line.
  4. Check the login. Start codex in a repo and send a short prompt. If Codex asks you to sign in, the login did not save.
  5. Pick where the login is stored. The cli_auth_credentials_store setting in config.toml chooses file, keyring, auto or ephemeral. auto uses the OS credential store when it exists and falls back to the file.

The auth page describes no other setup step for the CLI. The desktop app and IDE extension have their own “Sign in another way” and “Use API Key” buttons.

item.title: Codex with Ollama (2026): Local Models Setup and Memory
item.description: Codex with Ollama means running OpenAI’s Codex CLI against a model that Ollama serves, either on your own machine or in Ollama’s cloud. Ollama’s Codex page says you can start it with one command, ollama launch codex, or with codex --oss, which uses Ollama as the local provider. Codex still edits your files and runs your commands. The model decides how well it does that, so pick one that handles tool calls.

item.title: Codex MCP: Add, Configure and Check Servers (2026)
item.description:
What is MCP in Codex CLI?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Codex use tools that live outside it. An MCP server is a program or a remote service that offers tools, such as “search notes” or “save this fact”. Codex CLI, the desktop app and the IDE extension all load the same MCP servers, so you set a server up once.

item.title: Codex Skills: Folders, Install and Disable (2026)
item.description:
A Codex skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file. The file holds a name, a description and the steps for one job. Codex sees the name and description at the start, and reads the full steps only when a task matches. Put the skill in the right folder, and Codex finds it on its own or when you type $ and its name.

item.title: How to Install Codex CLI (2026): macOS, Windows, Linux
item.description:
To install Codex CLI, run one command for your system. On macOS or Linux, run curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh. On Windows, use the PowerShell line below. Then run codex in a project folder and choose Sign in with ChatGPT. Codex CLI is OpenAI’s coding agent that runs in your terminal, on your own machine.

What is Codex CLI?

Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally. It reads the files in your project folder, edits them, and runs the tools already on your machine. It is separate from the Codex web agent at chatgpt.com/codex and from the Codex desktop app. The official README lists the IDE extension, the desktop app (codex app) and the cloud agent as other ways to use Codex.
